title: Localization-Preserving Width Allocation (LPWA-50), one prospectively frozen candidate
motivation: Phase 15: uniform narrowing to 0.50x costs -1.80 AP on arm B; class correctness given a found box stays ~97% while localization recall@0.50 falls 7.0 points. Budget audit: the class head is <2% of params and the box branch is already floored at 64 ch, so the reallocatable budget is P5 (32.8%) -> P3/P4 (9.2%). Hypothesis: at equal params, moving width from the P5 path to the P3/P4 paths recovers localization and AP.
one_candidate_rule: Exactly one candidate. No variants, no ratio changes, no tuning after any result.

candidate.name: lpwa50
candidate.design_rule:
Phase 16A design (no training): solve the Localization-Preserving Width Allocation (LPWA-50).

Rule fixed BEFORE solving (revision 2, user-set budget box; stated in the Phase 16A pre-registration):
  * topology, depth, head design identical to YOLO11n / uniform 0.50x (runs_p15/w050)
  * stem layers 0-2 stay at the uniform 0.50x width
  * every P3/P4-resolution layer (backbone 3-6, neck 13, 16, 17, 19) is scaled by ONE shared factor a
  * every P5-resolution layer (backbone 7-10, neck 20 and 22) is scaled by ONE shared factor b,
    b in {0.50, 0.55, ..., 1.00} of the uniform 0.50x width
  * HARD budget: params <= 811,144 (uniform 0.50x). TARGET: GFLOPs@512 <= 2.0. ABSOLUTE cap: < 2.707 (0.75x)
  * choose the LARGEST a (0.01 grid) for which some b meets params and the 2.0 target; at that a take
    the LARGEST b that meets params. If no a > 1 meets the 2.0 target, fall back to the 2.707 cap
    with b = 0.50 and record that the target was infeasible.
  * the head is unchanged: the class branch is <2% of params and the box branch is already floored
    at 64 channels (reg_max*4) at every width (phase16/p16_budget_audit.json)
Channels are realised with Ultralytics' make_divisible(.., 8), i.e. the same rounding as Phase 15.

training.source: configs/experiments.yaml [train], identical to runs_p4/r512 except init
training.note: identical to Phase 15 (runner p16_run.py derived from p15_run.py)

seed_rule: All five seeds run directly; no screening subset. Paired with U50/w100 seeds of the same index.

evaluation.arms: Phase 9 frozen arms over the official-val union (2439 images): arm B = source-INDEPENDENT (213 families, 411 files), arm A = source-EXPOSED (1047 families, 2028 files). Manifests/hashes: phase9/arm_freeze_record.json.
evaluation.inference: imgsz 512, conf 0.001, NMS IoU 0.7, max_det 300, top-100 per image
evaluation.scorer: pycocotools COCO AP@[.50:.95], maxDets 100, 8 categories (as Phase 9/12)
evaluation.decomposition: Phase 12 matching rules: conf 0.25, greedy one-to-one class-agnostic match at IoU 0.50; strict 0.75
evaluation.also: clean-val (268 originals) Ultralytics val at every checkpoint, descriptive only

success_criteria.rule: LPWA-50 SUCCEEDS iff all three gates pass
success_criteria.G1_primary_AP: mean over seeds of Delta_i = AP_B(lpwa50, i) - AP_B(U50, i) at 24570 is >= +0.75 AP. The paired 95% t CI (df=4) is reported; statistical significance is NOT required.
success_criteria.G2_mechanism: mean over seeds of Delta locR50_B (localization recall @IoU .50, arm B, Phase 12 rules) > 0. Mechanistic corroboration; no separate significance test.
success_criteria.G3_resources: params <= 811,144 AND GFLOPs@512 < 2.707 (target <= 2.0, met at design: 1.965)

secondary.noninferiority_vs_w100: Phase 15 rule: one-sided paired t, margin -1.5 AP, arm B @24570 (single comparison, no Holm)
secondary.superiority_vs_U50: one-sided paired t p reported (not a gate)
secondary.at_18270: all of the above repeated at 18270
secondary.exposure: Delta on arm A and interaction I = Delta_B - Delta_A vs U50 and vs w100; family bootstrap 1000
secondary.decomposition: class-agnostic AP, AP50/75, locR50/75, conditional class correctness, FP/family
secondary.convergence: Phase 15 rule: still improving iff mean gain 18270->24570 > 0.5 AP and one-sided p < 0.05
secondary.resources: params, GFLOPs, fp16 size, peak VRAM, GPU b1/b16 latency, CPU b1 latency vs U50 and w100

decision.success: proceed to Phase 17: localization-focused distillation into LPWA-50 (separately frozen)
decision.failure: STOP architecture work; no second allocation, no module search

integrity_rules: The clean test split is not inspected during development.
The margin and all rules are not changed after any result is seen.
Best-validation checkpoints are never the primary outcome; the primary is the fixed 24570-update checkpoint.
No edge-device speed claim is made from desktop GPU timings.
No change to the candidate after any seed is trained.
